name: Doppyun Donpisha
source:
Hero is an aspiring photograph to cover women photo sessions. But he actually is tired of those neat photos and wants to shoot usual girls outdoors in their natural environment and without being caught by the police. He looks up to a colleague who agrees to accept the hero as his apprentice if he made nude photos of a list of girls.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/07/vn-of-month-december-1993.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名立志以拍摄女性写真为业的摄影师，但他已经厌倦了那些整洁、刻意摆拍的照片，更想走到户外，在普通女孩的日常环境中拍下她们自然的模样，同时还不能被警察抓住。他非常仰慕一名同行，对方答应收他为徒，条件是他必须按照一份名单，拍到上面每个女孩的裸体照片。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/07/vn-of-month-december-1993.html]vndbreview[/url]]
